contract: Compare virtual environment custody using the resolved environment root, preserving distinct environments that share one base Python binary.
An alias to the same controller environment cannot become project authority through a different lexical path. Reject before dependency probe or workload execution.
Recheck materialized/reused project interpreter custody before probing or returning it; an existing cache that is the controller itself cannot bypass the explicit-interpreter guard.
Preserve valid independent lexical entrypoints, native dependency derivation, typed errors, CLI grammar and immutable installed baselines.
expected_tests: Real venv directory alias to controller rejects at public resolver; distinct venvs sharing base Python remain admitted.
Materializer returning controller rejects before probe; valid independent derived/cached environments retain existing behavior.
forbidden_surfaces: Manual dependency repair or environment authority flags
remaining: Affected behavioral/native/package checks and combined successor canonical reconciliation remain required.
